label: Company name
help:
What name should appear in reports and automation titles?
Example: Acme Studio. Use the company name, not a client or Project name.

label: Company operating context
help:
What does your company do, who does it serve, and how does your team work?
Include your main services and useful operating context.
Example: An AI lab building client software; development is tracked in Multica, admin work in Notion, and discussions in Discord.

label: Company timezone
help:
Which timezone should define company days and reporting weeks?
Choose where your team plans its work. Example: Asia/Kuala_Lumpur.

label: Group daily context by
help:
Should each context snapshot cover one Project or a whole Department?
Choose Project for isolated client/product work; Department when people and work routinely span Projects. Only the chosen mode appears in generated skills.

label: How should projects match across platforms?

options.label: Notion is canonical; IDs, then exact names (Recommended)
options.render:
- Use the configured Notion Projects inventory as canonical.
- Match other platforms by stored IDs first; otherwise require one unique normalized exact Project name. Retain resolved IDs in the cache.
- Assign Work through its exact Project relation or Project URL. Use the configured Department relation for report membership.
- Report missing, conflicting or ambiguous matches; do not guess or create resources.

options.label: Notion is canonical; explicit IDs and relations only
options.render:
- Use the configured Notion Projects inventory as canonical.
- Match other platforms only through explicitly configured IDs. Assign Work through its exact Project relation or Project URL.
- Use the configured Department relation for report membership.
- Report missing, conflicting or ambiguous mappings; never infer matches from names or create resources.

help:
Choose how Notion Projects, Multica boards and Discord conversations refer to the same project.
Recommended: use stored IDs where available, then one unique matching name. Choose Custom to name a different canonical source or mapping rule; type directly on that row.

label: Which cadences may propagate authorized outputs?
help:
May Daily or Weekly apply their outputs to external services?
Neither keeps all results local. Daily enables configured follow-ups; Weekly enables configured report/memory sync and delivery. Selecting a cadence does not choose its destinations.

help:
What other evidence should Daily read: discussions, CRM, calendars or saved chats?
For each entry name the existing read tool, exact scope and fetch instructions.
Example: A Discord Projects forum, including active/archived threads and in-window messages. Never enter tokens here.

label: Local memory location
help:
Where should the generated prompts read and write weekly operating memory?
Default uses weeks/<week>/<mode>-memory/. A custom workspace-relative .md pattern must contain <week> and <unit-id> so units and weeks cannot overwrite each other.

label: Decision detail

options.label: Standard
options.render: Retain context, explicit choice, alternatives, rationale and outcome when evidenced.

options.label: Lightweight
options.render: Retain the explicit choice, reason and outcome when evidenced.

help:
How much detail should an evidenced decision retain?
Standard includes context, alternatives, rationale and outcome; Lightweight keeps choice, reason and outcome. Custom adds your preferences. Routine updates still do not qualify as decisions.

label: People evidence focus

options.label: Contributions and unblocking
options.render: Focus on contributions, dependencies, attempted solutions and useful unblocking interventions.

options.label: Delivery and commitments
options.render: Focus on evidenced completed work, open commitments and blockers.

help:
What should People progress emphasize?
Contributions and unblocking includes dependencies and useful interventions; Delivery focuses on completed work, commitments and blockers. No option authorizes invented performance ratings.

label: SOP evidence focus

options.label: Procedure capture
options.render: Retain evidenced file inputs, observed method, output files and acceptance controls.

options.label: Approved-baseline comparison
options.render: Compare equivalent accepted work only against a supplied approved baseline; retain supported differences without ratings or invented timings.

help:
Should reusable workflows be captured, or compared with an existing approved baseline?
Choose Procedure capture unless you have baselines to supply. SOP evidence still needs input files, an observed method and output files.

label: Stale-work trigger

options.label: Seven days
options.render: Establish staleness from timestamps showing no meaningful update for seven days, not absent fetched messages alone.

options.label: Custom age
options.render: Establish staleness from timestamps showing no meaningful update for {days} days, not absent fetched messages alone.

help:
When should a lack of meaningful updates trigger a follow-up?
Standard is seven days; Age threshold lets you enter another number. Overdue or blocked Work can need attention sooner. Incomplete collection alone never proves staleness.

label: Documentation criteria

options.label: Consequential missing evidence
options.render: Request missing outcome, evidence, rationale or next action only when it materially affects a supported conclusion.

options.label: Outcome and verification
options.render: Request only a missing claimed result or its verification evidence when consequential.

help:
What missing information warrants asking the Work owner a question?
Standard covers consequential missing results, evidence, rationale or next actions. Evidence only narrows this to claimed results and verification. Avoid requesting cosmetic fields.
